description.advisor-unavailable: The graph service is not answering right now. The deck itself is unaffected.
description.axis-combo-completion: Whether the card completes a known combo with cards already in the deck, per Commander Spellbook.
description.axis-edhrec-synergy: How much more often decks with this commander play the card than decks in general (EDHREC). A high bar is proven practice, not theory — and it stays empty when EDHREC has no data for the commander.
description.axis-identity: How strongly the card matches what this deck is already doing — its themes and its commander's plan. Fed by every channel that reads the card as on-theme.
description.axis-resource-bridge: Whether the card produces a resource the deck wants but under-produces — treasures for a treasure payoff, card draw for empty hands. It bridges the gap between what your cards care about and what they actually get.
description.axis-role-gap: Whether the card fills a role the deck is short on — ramp, card draw, interaction, win conditions — measured against the role targets on the diagnostics tab.
description.bracket-assumed: The deck claims no bracket, so it is read at bracket {{number}}. Set one on the chip beside the deck name if that is wrong.
description.bracket-claimed: The deck claims bracket {{number}}, and the advice is graded against it. Change it on the chip beside the deck name.
description.build: Ranked by what your deck is short on.
description.by-the-book: Built by the book — nothing agreed at the table.
description.combos-one-short: The missing piece is one click away from the deck.
description.commander-inferred: No commander set — the analysis assumes {{name}}.
description.commander-only: The advisor reads Commander decks. Other formats will follow.
description.curve-eminence: The Ur-Dragon's eminence is counted in: Dragons sit one lower than printed.
description.curve-legend: Bars: cards in the deck · line: target. Both count non-land cards.
description.curve-shape: The targets are a shape over your non-land slots: raising one column lowers the others.
description.define-themes: Pick what the deck is meant to play. Suggestions, swaps and fills argue for it from then on — even while few cards in the list say so yet.
description.done: {{count}} cards, right on target. Keep adding for a little more flexibility, or start polishing what you've already got.
description.empty-deck: Put cards into the deck and the advisor will read it.
description.fill-complete: The deck is already full — nothing to fill.
description.ignored: The advisor never suggests these cards for this deck.
description.kept: The advisor never proposes these as cuts.
description.no-combos: No known combos in the deck — Commander Spellbook knows nothing here.
description.no-commander: No commander in the deck — without one the advisor cannot scope anything. Put one in the command zone.
description.no-cuts: No cuts proposed — nothing stands out as expendable.
description.no-suggestions: No suggestions — the deck is not obviously missing anything.
description.no-swaps: No exchanges proposed — nothing the deck can spare overlaps with what it is offered.
description.no-theme-read: Too few cards pull the same way to read a direction from them. Tell us what the deck is going for and the suggestions will argue for it.
description.note-bridge-no-gaps: Deck produces everything it wants — the resource bridge found no gaps.
description.note-combo-suggestions-capped: {{amount}} more combo completions not shown — a deck supports only so many lines, so the {{limit}} most popular are argued.
description.note-combos-below-bracket-three: Combo completions are not scored below bracket 3 — two-card combos are a higher-power play. Raise the power level to score them.
description.note-combos-hidden-below-bracket-four: {{amount}} combo completions hidden — two-card infinites and Ruthless-rated combos are a bracket 4+ play. Raise the bracket to see them.
description.note-combos-hidden-no-payoff: {{amount}} combo completions hidden — they produce triggers this deck runs no payoff for.
description.note-commander-not-in-graph: Commander is not in the card graph.
description.note-commander-rejected: The nominated commander was rejected — it is not in the card graph or cannot legally be a commander — so one was inferred instead.
description.note-deck-size-scaled: Targets are scaled to a {{size}}-card deck from their 99-card tuning — treat the ranges as guidance rather than measured data.
description.note-demoted-bucket-saturation: {{amount}} suggestions demoted — they add to a bucket the deck is already over ({{buckets}}).
description.note-demoted-excluded-themes: {{amount}} suggestions demoted — they read as themes you excluded.
description.note-demoted-type-saturation: {{amount}} suggestions demoted — the deck is over its type targets ({{types}}).
description.note-edhrec-missing: EDHREC has no deck statistics for {{commander}}, so suggestions come from card mechanics and combos only.
description.note-edhrec-pending: EDHREC statistics for {{commander}} are being fetched — suggestions will refine themselves in a moment.
description.note-extra-turns-withheld: {{amount}} extra-turn spells withheld — brackets 1 through 3 play none. Raise the bracket to see them.
description.note-fill-already-at-size: Already at {{current}} cards — nothing to fill.
description.note-fill-bucket-over-target: {{bucket}} was already over target before filling ({{current}} against {{low}}-{{high}}); adding cards cannot bring it down — cut something instead.
description.note-fill-no-arrangement: No arrangement satisfied the hard constraints.
description.note-fill-pool-too-small: Only {{candidates}} candidates for {{slots}} slots — widen the budget or the colour identity.
description.note-fill-solver-unavailable: The solver is not installed on the server, so filling is unavailable.
description.note-focus-no-matches: Nothing matched {{focus}} within this deck's colours and budget — showing everything instead.
description.note-game-changers-at-cap: {{amount}} game changers withheld — the deck already plays bracket 3's {{cap}}. Raise the bracket to see them.
description.note-game-changers-withheld: {{amount}} game changers withheld at this power level — brackets 1 and 2 play none. Raise the power level to see them.
description.note-identity-overridden: Suggestions are scoped to the deck's claimed colours ({{colors}}) rather than {{commander}}'s own identity — a Rule 0 house rule.
description.note-mass-land-denial-withheld: {{amount}} mass-land-denial cards withheld — brackets 1 through 3 play none. Raise the bracket to see them.
description.note-no-legal-commander: No legal commander found in the decklist, so nothing can be scoped.
description.note-promoted-pinned-themes: {{amount}} suggestions promoted to make room for {{themes}} — the themes you favoured.
description.note-themes-focus-wins: {{label}} is excluded, but you asked to focus on it — the focus wins here.
description.note-themes-pin-wins: {{labels}}: pinned and excluded at once — the pin wins.
description.note-why-bridge-no-gaps: The resource bridge looks for resources your cards care about but the deck under-produces. No gap is good news — that channel simply had nothing to argue this time.
description.note-why-combo-suggestions-capped: Every combo line found is ranked, but only the most-played ones argue for a slot — sixty combos named at once is a catalog, not advice.
description.note-why-combos-below-bracket-three: Combo completion only scores at bracket 3 and above — below that, assembling an infinite is not what the deck is trying to do.
description.note-why-combos-hidden-below-bracket-fou: Two-card infinites and Ruthless-rated combos define bracket 4+. Below that they are hidden entirely rather than ranked low, so the list never nudges a deck out of its own bracket.
description.note-why-combos-hidden-no-payoff: A combo that produces a trigger — magecraft, landfall, an ETB, and so on — is a completion only if the deck already runs something that cares about that trigger. With no payoff for it, the combo would be the only card in the 99 interested in what it makes, so it is hidden rather than suggested as a finisher.
description.note-why-deck-size-scaled: All role and type targets were tuned on 99-card decks. A deck that legally runs another size gets the corridors scaled linearly — honest guidance, but not re-measured data.
description.note-why-demoted-bucket-saturation: Suggestions are ranked by what the deck is missing. A card that mostly adds to a role already over target still appears, just below the cards that fix a real gap — demoted, never hidden.
description.note-why-demoted-excluded-themes: An excluded theme is a preference, not a ban: its cards sink in proportion to how much of the card is that theme, so a strong all-round card can still surface.
description.note-why-demoted-type-saturation: The same rule for card types: over the type target, cards of that type rank lower instead of disappearing.
description.note-why-extra-turns-withheld: Chained extra turns are a bracket 4+ play by the bracket definitions, so lower brackets never see them suggested.
description.note-why-game-changers-at-cap: The bracket system caps game changers per bracket. Suggesting more than the deck may legally play would argue it out of its own bracket, so the surplus is withheld entirely.
description.note-why-game-changers-withheld: Brackets 1 and 2 play no game changers at all, so none are suggested there.
description.note-why-mass-land-denial-withheld: Mass land denial is a bracket 4+ play by the bracket definitions, so lower brackets never see it suggested.
description.note-why-promoted-pinned-themes: Pinned themes get guaranteed representation: their best cards hold reserved slots even when other channels score higher.
description.off-theme: {{share}}% of them read as “{{theme}}” — a theme your deck doesn't play. What's popular for this commander isn't necessarily right for your build.
description.partial-coverage: {{amount}} cards could not be resolved and are missing from this analysis.
description.pool-query: Only cards matching this search are suggested — for example eur<5, -t:artifact, set:one, year>=2020, r:rare, is:creature. Basic lands stay available whatever you restrict. Set and year mean the printing held for a card, not every one ever released.
description.quotas: How many cards fill each role. The target corridors are suggestions — drag them where your deck wants them.
description.refine: Watch the shapes above while you swap. Every suggestion below is a straight trade: one card out, one in, the deck stays at {{count}}.
description.replace: What does similar work in this slot. One click takes the card out and puts the chosen one in.
description.rule-zero: What the table agreed to. The colours and the deck size go into the analysis, the rest is a statement about the deck.
description.setup-banner: Instead of for what it read off the cards.
description.setup-bracket: The bracket decides how hard the advisor plays: what it offers at all, and how many Game Changers it thinks you can get away with.
description.setup-bracket-shared: This one goes on the deck itself rather than into your advisor settings — it is what the table agreed to, so it shows on the deck and in anything you share.
description.setup-budget: A price ceiling, an era, a rarity — the advisor searches only what is left. Basic lands stay available.
description.setup-shape: The curve every suggestion is graded against. You can drag it later in the cockpit.
description.setup-themes: Pick what it is meant to be doing and every suggestion argues for it — even while few cards say so yet. Answer none of this and the advisor works it out from the cards.
description.shaping-intro: The advisor reshapes its raw ranking before showing it: it withholds what the bracket forbids, demotes what the deck already has enough of, and promotes what you favoured. Each adjustment is listed here with its reason.
description.swaps: What the freed slot buys. One click takes the left card out and puts the right one in.
description.theme-axis: {{cards}} of {{spells}} nonland cards read as “{{name}}”. The radius compares each theme against the strongest one — a shape, not percentages.
description.theme-evidence: {{themed}} of {{spells}} non-land cards carry a theme.
description.theme-thin: Thin evidence: the strongest theme rests on {{count}} cards.
description.themes: What the deck is visibly working towards, as shares.
description.trim: Every card below is a straight cut, no replacement attached.
description.types: What the deck is made of, against targets measured from decks like it — drag them where your deck wants them. A creature can be ramp: roles count jobs, this counts card types.
description.why-scale: Each axis against the strongest suggestion in this list — the rim means “strongest here”, not “good”.

error.fill-busy: The solver is busy right now — try again in a moment.
error.fill-failed: The fill failed. The deck is unchanged.
error.pool-query-invalid: That search could not be read.
error.themes-unavailable: The theme list is unreachable right now.
